name: Mukhyamantri Kisan Kalyan Yojana (Madhya Pradesh)
amount: ₹6,000 a year in three instalments of ₹2,000, on top of PM-KISAN (₹12,000 in total)
description: Madhya Pradesh's top-up for farmers who already get PM-KISAN. It began in September 2020 and the state government has said it will continue.
benefits: An extra ₹6,000 a year, paid in three instalments of ₹2,000 by direct bank transfer, in addition to the ₹6,000 from PM-KISAN.
eligibility_text: Permanent residents of Madhya Pradesh who are registered under PM-KISAN with eKYC done and who have arable land they farm. Income-tax payers, elected representatives and government employees are not eligible.
steps: Register on PM-KISAN (pmkisan.gov.in) and finish eKYC.
Check that your land and bank details are correct in the records.
Contact your district or block agriculture office if the state instalment does not arrive.
source_organization: Farmer Welfare & Agriculture Development Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh
